hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: A 1:1 custom-curve hook for ETH/phiEth pools that intercepts every swap in beforeSwap, takes input from the PoolManager, calls phiEth.deposit() or phiEth.withdraw() to convert between ETH and phiEth at parity, and settles output back to the PoolManager via a BeforeSwapDelta. Liquidity addition is permanently blocked.
